title: Challenge fixture contains an additional untracked XSS sink and Option B has unplanned public admin/auth surfaces

original_titles.title: Challenge app: unplanned second XSS sink in the notes list render
Intended challenge weaknesses confirmed contained; Option B fixture carries two unplanned auth gaps

problem: challenge-app/public/app.js interpolates note.title, author_name and subject into li.innerHTML in addition to the documented comments XSS sink. Option B renders note titles/bodies into innerHTML and exposes /admin/overview without authentication; the fixture README says defects mirror Option A one-for-one, so these extra sinks/surfaces may be untracked or intentional.
impact: If these extra weaknesses are not in the ground-truth catalogue, participants may find valid vulnerabilities that cannot be scored or the exercise can leak unintended flags. If they are intentional, answer-key coverage must make that explicit.

evidence_paths: backend/seed.py: challenge fixtures and GT manifest
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Compare every challenge-app and Option B unsafe sink/route against the GT bug catalogue and hidden tests. Produce a machine-readable fixture-to-GT coverage report.
For every intended vulnerability, add exact location, severity, root-cause group, aliases, expected score and regression/hidden test. Ensure Option A/B parity is intentional.
For every unintended sink, replace innerHTML interpolation with DOM node creation and textContent; add XSS regression tests with markup-looking note title, body and author names.
For the Option B admin overview, either intentionally add the corresponding GT issue and test, or add server-side authentication/authorization and remove unsafe placeholder cookie logic.
Run an independent pre-flight vulnerability hunt on both variants and reconcile all findings before content freeze.

acceptance_criteria: Every exploitable sink is either intentionally in GT or fixed.
Option A/B GT coverage and difficulty parity are documented.
No untracked challenge vulnerability exists at content freeze.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: These are challenge-fixture defects, not necessarily vulnerabilities in the Bug Hunt platform. The owner must decide whether they are intended scoring targets.
